exposure: Histopathological presence of dermal elements in resected tissues at initial repair surgery for myelomeningocele
outcome: Development of dermoid or epidermoid cysts at myelomeningocele sites
cohort: The study included four out of 18 cases with myelomeningocele who required resection of parts or margins of neural structures during initial repair surgery.
finding: Prenatally existing cryptic dermoid elements in the caudal portion of neural structures and remnants of dermal elements overlapping the rostral margin of the neural placode are associated with the delayed occurrence of dermoid/epidermoid cysts.
followup_time: At least 1 year and 2 months (for Case 1)
